decisions.decision: project.GramCat returns a lazily-cached distinct GramCatOperations instance, NOT self.POS; the literal is-identity is dropped
decisions.why: spec.md was internally contradictory - section 4 wanted GramCat.Create to raise a helpful FP_ParameterError naming the replacements, sections 2/3 wanted project.GramCat is project.POS. Live verification proved these are mutually exclusive: with the is-identity, project.GramCat.Create("Transitive") reached POSOperations.Create and raised a bare TypeError, so the migration signpost was unreachable on the exact path FlexTools/FlexTrans callers take. Repo owner ruled to keep the override reachable. Section 3s concern about two CRUD surfaces is not reintroduced: GramCatOperations stays a subclass with one inherited implementation plus one deliberate raising override.
decisions.rejected: Keeping project.GramCat is project.POS and letting migrating callers receive a stock TypeError with no pointer, relying on MIGRATION_GUIDE alone
